ile_formula: ILE = mean_{γ ∈ used} |log est(γ) − log truth(γ)|; used = {γ : est(γ) !== nothing && est(γ) > 0 && truth(γ) > 0}

reference_check.robustness_definition: rho = 0.99 - running-max PoCA reward; shared crosswalk_rollout used by both the reference generator and this run
reference_check.reference_dt_phys_source: NOT stored in hist.json; recovered from paper/experiments/idm_reference.jl AdversarialCrosswalk(; dt=DT_DIST/NSUB) with DT_DIST=0.2, NSUB=4 => 0.05

budget_accounting: nominal budget B=25000 per arm; the charged evaluations of each arm are in metrics.json
gpd_policy: unconstrained and xi>=0 on the SAME buffer at predefined anchors; anchor sensitivity reported; no ground-truth anchor selection
measured_quantity: failure-probability curve at real trajectory dimension against a 26M-rollout reference
regularization: MAP D-prior covariance floor (D .= max.(D, 1e-4)) in the FactorEM inner M-step, vendored SGM
problem_def: AV crosswalk, 30 disturbance steps x 5 channels, dt_phys=0.05, ascale=0.60; rho = 0.99 - PoCA
threshold_grid_policy: gamma=0.08 and gamma=0 are distinct thresholds under the simulator definition: a non-collision centre separation in [1.4000, 1.4064] m can satisfy rho <= 0.08. The 26M reference happens to contain the same 808 events at both.
